title: Cartoon Octopuses
brief: A variety of octopuses in different colours and with arms in different formations, in a more cartoonish style.
image_policy: Untouched full-resolution generated PNGs; one unique image per matching pair.

entries.pose: A balanced low fan: exactly eight arms, four sweeping left and four sweeping right in separate tiers below the mantle; all tips curl upward. Wide and welcoming.
entries.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one square memory-game card, one unique image for one matching pair.
Create exactly ONE friendly cartoon octopus, isolated on an opaque plain warm ivory-cream background (#FFF8EB). More cartoonish than painted natural-history art: bold smooth dark-plum rounded outlines, large simple white oval eyes with dark pupils and tiny highlights, a small cheerful smile, a plump rounded mantle, soft flat cel shading with one subtle painted highlight. Rounded rubbery tapering arms with a single simple row of pale round suction cups where the underside is visible. Rich appealing colour, clean children's picture-book cartoon, polished hand-drawn 2D illustration, very light paper grain only. The octopus has exactly EIGHT arms in total, each visually separate from base to tip; no extra arms, no detached pieces, no fins. Front view. One fully visible large subject, balanced at the center of a square, with all extremities at least 10-12% from every canvas edge; full silhouette occupies roughly 76% of square. Clear silhouette readable at 96px. No scenery, props, clothing, bubbles, rocks, seabed, water, text, numbers, labels, card border, watermark or cast shadow.
Colour palette: rich violet purple, lavender undersides.
Arm formation: A balanced low fan: exactly eight arms, four sweeping left and four sweeping right in separate tiers below the mantle; all tips curl upward. Wide and welcoming.
